Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Little by little, things began to change. Anna keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. Best of all, the inn has a wide veranda.

On Tuesday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. The library desk looked quieter than usual that evening. People around Anna often share different ideas about the library desk. In fact, this chair is comfortable.
Anna's dream job is to be a driver. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The bus card machine has become an important part of daily life. She is always willing to help.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Best of all, she arranged the flowers in a vase.
The experience taught Anna more than any book could. Anna will take part in a volleyball match in July. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
